narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Touching circles meet at a place, so that place can be the third corner.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But that place lies on the base itself.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The three corners would then lie on one line, which is not a triangle.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble shows two touching circles and a corner drawn on the touching place; the bubble is struck through

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Radii that add to less than the base make the circles miss.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Radii that add to the base make them touch.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Radii that add to more than the base make them cross.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>Your turn. A base of nine has radii of three and four. Do the circles touch, miss or cross?
